name: g_saveCodeAlphabet
comment: Canonical 64-character Japanese Hiragana alphabet table (128 bytes, UTF-16LE) used for Spell of Restoration (Fukkatsu no Jumon); maps 6-bit values (0..63) to/from Japanese syllabary characters (44 basic hiragana plus 20 voiced kana: ga, za, da, ba); used by SaveCode_Decode, SaveCode_Encode, and SaveCode_ValidateChar.
evidence: Referenced via literal 0x005EF470 in SaveCode_Decode (0x005EF3CC), literal 0x005EF3C8 in SaveCode_Encode (0x005EF33C), and literal 0x005EF4EC in SaveCode_ValidateChar (0x005EF474); catalogued in symbols.json as s_SaveCodeAlphabet; table consists of 64 UTF-16LE characters in rodata_00725000.s starting with L'あ' (0x3042), L'い' (0x3044) through L'ぼ' (0x307C).

name: g_saveCodeCheckDigitWeights
comment: Array of 6 double-precision probability weights (48 bytes: 0.1, 5e-5, 0.001, 0.1, 0.05, 0.001) used by SaveCode_GenerateCheckDigits to accumulate cumulative thresholds for weighted random selection of 5 check digits from 100 candidate slots.
evidence: Referenced via literal 0x005F07A0 in SaveCode_GenerateCheckDigits (0x005F0408) as *(double *)(g_005f07a0 + index * 8); 6 consecutive 64-bit IEEE-754 floats in rodata_00725000.s: 0x3FB999999999999A (0.1), 0x3F0A36E2EB1C432D (5e-5), 0x3F50624DD2F1A9FC (0.001), 0x3FB999999999999A (0.1), 0x3FA999999999999A (0.05), and 0x3F50624DD2F1A9FC (0.001).

name: g_saveCodeFixed20InputAlphabet
comment: Input character table (128 bytes, UTF-16LE) for the fixed 20-character Spell of Restoration encoder (SaveCode_EncodeFixed20); linearly scanned to map 20 input UTF-16 characters in 0x3000..0x30FC (44 basic hiragana plus 20 voiced kana: ga, za, da, ba) to 6-bit index values (0..63).
evidence: Referenced via literal 0x005EF8E8 in SaveCode_EncodeFixed20 (0x005EF4F0); looped i = 0..63 comparing puVar12 = (u16 *)(0x0072F1F0 + i * 2) with input character IDs; 64 UTF-16LE characters in rodata_00725000.s identical to g_saveCodeAlphabet (L'あ'..L'ぼ').

name: g_saveCodeFixed20OutputAlphabet
comment: Output character alphabet table (128 bytes, UTF-16LE) for the fixed 20-character Spell of Restoration encoder (SaveCode_EncodeFixed20); indexed by scrambled 6-bit values to emit alphanumeric/hiragana characters (10 fullwidth digits '０'..'９', 44 basic hiragana, 'を', 'ん', small kana 'っ'/'ゃ'/'ゅ'/'ょ', '゛', '゜', 'ー', and fullwidth space '　').
evidence: Referenced via literal 0x005EF8F0 in SaveCode_EncodeFixed20 (0x005EF4F0) as *(u16 *)(0x0072F272 + uVar5 * 2) when packing output words; table of 64 UTF-16LE characters in rodata_00725000.s starting at 0x0072F272 (preceded by 2-byte 0x0000 alignment pad at 0x0072F270) from L'０' (0xFF10) through L'　' (0x3000).

name: g_saveCodeVariableInputAlphabet
comment: Input character table (128 bytes, UTF-16LE) for the variable-length Spell of Restoration encoder (SaveCode_EncodeVariable); linearly scanned to map 18 to 52 input UTF-16 characters in 0x3000..0x30FC (44 basic hiragana plus 15 voiced kana ga/za/ba and 5 semi-voiced kana pa/pi/pu/pe/po) to 6-bit index values (0..63).
evidence: Referenced via literal 0x005EFD2C in SaveCode_EncodeVariable (0x005EF914); looped i = 0..63 comparing puVar7 = (u16 *)(0x0072F2F4 + i * 2) with input character IDs; 64 UTF-16LE characters in rodata_00725000.s starting with L'あ' (0x3042) and ending with L'ぱ'..'ぽ' (0x3071..0x307D), replacing the 'だ'..'ど' series from the fixed table.

name: g_saveCodeVariableOutputAlphabet
comment: Output character alphabet table (128 bytes, UTF-16LE) for the variable-length Spell of Restoration encoder (SaveCode_EncodeVariable); indexed by scrambled 6-bit values to emit alphanumeric/hiragana characters (10 fullwidth digits '０'..'９', 44 basic hiragana, 'を', 'ん', small kana 'っ'/'ゃ'/'ゅ'/'ょ', '゛', '゜', fullwidth space '　', and 'ー').
evidence: Referenced via literal 0x005EFD34 in SaveCode_EncodeVariable (0x005EF914) as *(u16 *)(0x0072F376 + index * 2); table of 64 UTF-16LE characters in rodata_00725000.s starting at 0x0072F376 (preceded by 2-byte 0x0000 alignment pad at 0x0072F374) from L'０' (0xFF10) through L'ー' (0x30FC); differs from fixed-20 output alphabet by swapping the last two entries (space at 62, dash at 63).
